name: drop-zone
title: DropZone
description: Drop target for contract files. A real file input behind a visible "Choose files" label; drag and drop is an enhancement.

a11y.pattern: Native <input type="file"> (visually hidden, focusable) + <label> styled as a button
keyboard: Focuses the file input; its label shows the focus ring
aria: The input is named by the visible "Choose files" label and described by the heading and hint
A polite live region announces "2 files ready"
Drag and drop adds convenience only: every function works with the keyboard
a11y.notes: Validate file types in your application; accept is only a hint to the picker.
